season.source: https://www.summerscountywv.gov/parksandrec ('Within the boundaries of the Bluestone Wildlife Management area sits several primitive campgrounds: Bertha, Cedar Branch, Shanklin Ferry, and Mouth of Indian Creek ... Each of the camping areas are open seasonally May through November, water levels permitting'), read 2026-10-21

note: Summers County-run primitive camping area on the New River at the end of Shanklins Ferry Road, the southernmost of the Bluestone WMA camping areas, near the Virginia line. A playground and shooting range are nearby. Fire rings and some tables. CAVEATS: nobody has reported what size rig fits - sites are dirt pads reached by gravel county roads, so scout before bringing EKKO in; the area floods in high water and parts may flood more often during the ongoing Bluestone Dam work (DNR District 4, 304-256-6947, has gate-closure updates). --Claude  AWH 2026-10-11: kept, though we can't tell whether the sites suit RVs. --Claude
summary: Summers County Parks & Rec page confirms Shanklin Ferry as one of its four primitive Bluestone WMA campgrounds, $15/night/site (fees already manual), and gives the season: changed year_round:false -> May-November (water levels permitting). DNR's Bluestone WMA map (updated 2022-10-11) labels Shanklins Ferry upper and lower campgrounds. Neither the county page nor DNR's District 4 page says anything about Shanklin's Ferry and the Bluestone Dam construction (no closure notice found), so no status written. Not stated on any official page: site count, rig size, toilets, reservations (derived values left). Note trimmed of the site-count, toilets/water/hookups/reservation, fee, season and phone restatements.
flags: Conflicting DNR page: WV DNR's District 4 WMA page (https://wvdnr.gov/lands-waters/wildlife-management-areas/district-4-wildlife-management-areas/, read 2026-10-21) says under '51. Bluestone Lake' 'On the WMA: Camping is not permitted', while DNR's own Bluestone WMA map labels the Shanklins Ferry campgrounds and Summers County lists it with a $15 fee (same conflict as Cedar Branch 14062).
Criteria (already accepted by AWH 2026-10-11): no operator or agency page says whether a 23-ft motorhome fits; the county page says only 'All areas are primitive camping only'.
